patch.value: Reuse explicitly selected verified subanswers across runs

Opt-in cross-run reuse built on existing digests and core ledger records. Acceptance: matching source scope, snapshot, question, tool/model policy and consent identities reuse with zero new model calls; changing one source revision invalidates only dependent results; retain original provenance without double-counting usage. Provide typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, typed refusals and remedies, README/example, non-git public-tracker validation, seeded model-based state tests and concurrency interleavings.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked: core CLI supplies certified full reads, native item/history transactions and locks, not verified model subanswer reuse. pm-rlm prompt digests reuse within a run; replay verifies recorded work. pm-memory embedding caches and purpose consent are distinct; pm-context freshness manifests invalidate packet sections but do not authenticate RLM answers; pm-swarm coordinates native resources. Implement an explicit selected-call reuse command atop existing checkpoint records, immutable snapshots, replay verification and SDK CAS. Identity is opt-in at original execution, freezes history access, and binds tool/model policy plus consent revision. No cache discovery or implicit reuse.

Public-tracker copy measurement: 23 public items, 2 scoped, 3 original logical calls / 5 scripted protocol requests, 2 reused subanswers / 0 new requests, one changed revision caused one dependent refusal while one independent child reused, new counters all zero, compact JSON 944 bytes; source archive unchanged.
